gate_a_structural.comments: Complete schema conformance across topic.json, claims.json, assessment.json, 6 diagrams, and editorial artifacts.

gate_b_evidence.comments: Claims are strictly grounded in RFC 6454, RFC 6265bis, RFC 6455, W3C Fetch Metadata, CWE-352, and OWASP Cheat Sheets. All sources verified.

gate_c_causal.comments: Rigorous causal chain grounded in Origin-Context Confusion. The exploitability boolean structure correctly specifies the OR gate across SameSite bypasses and transport pathways.

gate_d_learning_and_safety.comments: Learning objectives are action-oriented and measurable. Safety contract explicitly accounts for side-effect risk and data exposure risk. Assessment rubric features 6 dimensions with levels 0-4 and common learner errors.

feedback_items.note: Ensure the OR gate in exploitability.conditions explicitly covers both SameSite=None form POST and SameSite=Lax top-level GET navigations to reflect modern browser behavior accurately.
Include a transfer test scenario (Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking) alongside a practical calibration scenario to evaluate both novel protocol contexts and standard web application boundaries.
